تغترفون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَرِفُونَ (taḡtarifūna) /taɣ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# تُغْتَرَفُونَ (tuḡtarafūna) /tuɣ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
